Ivey Calls for More Congressional Action on AI Risks
videos.description: Democratic Representative Glenn Ivey of Maryland reacts to news that OpenAI alerted more than a dozen organizations that its models may have hacked or disrupted their sites, saying Congress and the White House should be taking emerging AI risks more seriously. He also discusses data-center power costs and the Democratic outlook heading into the midterms. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
